chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mismar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said to me: When you enter Mecca, complete [the prayer] on the day you enter.
ai.seo_question: How should one perform prayer when entering Mecca according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's chain in al-Istibsar establishes the specific ruling for travelers entering Mecca, mandating the completion (tamam) of the four-rak'ah prayer on the day of arrival rather than shortening it (qasr). This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it highlights the distinction between the status of Mecca as a permanent residence for its inhabitants and a temporary stop for travelers, emphasizing the sanctity of the Haramayn. The narration underscores the practical application of travel prayer rules, ensuring pilgrims observe full prayer upon entering the sacred precincts.
